messages:
Morgan Lee: handing off - I need to drop offline in ~8m. Active incident INC-20260314-01 (P1 latency spike, hosted west-1). Pager triggered, ~17% 502s and 95th latency ~2.5s. I'm assigning driver -> Alex Chen, comms -> Priya Nair. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/p1-latency. Quick context: KV-cache warmup storm after a recent model roll, autoscaler didn't kick fast enough.
Alex Chen: on it. Confirming I'm primary driver. can you list current mitigation steps you kicked?
Morgan Lee: did a manual scale attempt (partial) and toggled fallback routing to smaller model for some low-priority routes. Kicked a warmup job for kv-populate but it's slow. Commands I ran:
```
# scale pool
redd scale --pool west-1-inference --count 8
# set routing fallback
redd routing update --policy fallback-small-model --scope hosted
```
Alex Chen: thanks. I'll retry scaling and watch autoscaler. If scale fails, I'll flip to emergency routing policy.
Priya Nair: noted, I'll start drafting a customer-facing blip and notify CS. What customers are impacted?
Morgan Lee: looks like several PLG customers in NA-west and a few enterprise routes hitting the hosted API. Severity: degraded (not total outage) but SLO breaches possible. Please notify CS + status page if latency doesn't improve in 15m.
Tariq Malik: FYI runbook step 4 suggests checking KV cache eviction thresholds and the model warmup queue length. You can query: `redd metrics kv.cache.evictions{region="west-1"}` and `redd jobs warmup.queue.size`. Also consider temporarily increasing kv cache size param: `redd config set kv_cache.max_entries 500000` — will reduce churn.
Alex Chen: running scale command again now. If pool doesn't respond I'll increase instance type to g5x2 for faster provisioning.
DeployBot: scaling event started for west-1-inference, request id: scale-2160001111-az1.
Alex Chen: scale request accepted. Watching instances boot.
Priya Nair: if scale takes >10m I'll post an interim update: "We're investigating increased latencies in US-West for hosted inference; mitigation in progress." Any notes on customer impact wording?
Morgan Lee: say: customers may experience higher latency and occasional 502s for requests routed to hosted-api in US-West. No data loss. CS ticket template: INC-20260314-01, include top logs and request ids if customers ask.
Alex Chen: instances coming up. I'm also running a targeted KV warmup for top 50 prefixes: `redd warmup --prefix-file /tmp/top50.txt --region west-1`. That should reduce cold KV misses.
Tariq Malik: thumbs up. After warmup, watch 95th latency and 502 rate. If 502 > 10% after scale, escalate to infra oncall.
Sam Ortiz: heads-up I'm OOO from 21:00 UTC tonight so overnight coverage on this region may be thin; if this persists past my shift please ping engineering manager for backup.
Priya Nair: ack. I'll keep CS looped and draft status. Planning to post at +15m unless metrics recover.
DeployBot: scaling event completed, 8 instances healthy (west-1-inference).
Alex Chen: seeing 95th drop to ~700ms and 502s down to 3% after warmup. Will keep monitoring for 20m. Priya, you still comms?
Priya Nair: yes I'm comms. I'll send a status page update now and coordinate with CS to triage impacted accounts.
Morgan Lee: great — leaving notes in the runbook and handoff doc. If anything regresses, Alex is driver, Priya is comms. I'm signing off. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: got it. tagging oncall-sre if escalation needed: @oncall-sre.
IncidentBot: INC-20260314-01 status changed -> Mitigated (monitoring).
Priya Nair: status update posted to status.redwood.ai and CS notified. Closing loop in 30m unless regressions.
Morgan Lee: thanks team.
